Strategy
The Tapiola Balance special mutual fund is a balanced fund that invests in equity markets as well as interest rate markets. The fund currently invests in fixed-income and equity funds managed by Tapiola Fund Management. The portfolio manager comments actively on the development of equities and interest rates, and weights asset classes according to the current market situation of the fund. The proportion of equities can vary between 15 and 65 per cent. Tapiola Balance is suitable for investors who are looking for a return higher than that of interest rate markets and a risk lower than that of equity markets. The recommended investment period is three years minimum.
